concern_results.conclusion: base_derived_candidate is a faithful extraction of the removed inline block (same git invocation, --text, untracked append, wording-only unified context) and now serves both the plain and combined paths; freeze_packet's 5-tuple threads candidate_hash through freeze_review_profile, composite_base, chain checks, completion checkpoint, and dispositions, with the prior_candidate_hash renames removing the shadowing that would have compared the material-change trigger against the predecessor; candidate_paths and egress scan correctly read candidate and packet respectively.

The reviewer-saw-it invariant survives the equality removal: startswith(candidate) refuses dropped hunks, spliced context, prepended decoy diffs, and unrelated packets, while owner selection and the wording-only changed-file comparison derive from the candidate so appended context cannot pull in unearned owners; the only accept-set widening is packets provably beginning with the full landing candidate.

Empty base-derived candidate is refused with empty_diff before the vacuously-true prefix check, --paths without --base is refused, the ambiguous diff-file+base+wording-only-proof triple is refused while the established bare diff-file+proof shape is preserved, and an in-worktree packet file moves the untracked-inclusive candidate in the refusal direction rather than toward false accept.

The new review-gate probe exercises A1-A12 as independently failable assertions (identity, widening, truncation, interleave, prepend, unrelated, bare diff-file, combined wording-only refusal, empty candidate) and the binder suite adds the cross-side case deriving base/paths from candidate_scope; the applied-mutation rows are discriminating per case, and the non-discriminating binder mutation is honestly recorded since that gate never passes --diff-file.

With no --diff-file, packet and candidate are the same bytes so both hashes keep today's values; bare --diff-file keeps candidate_sha256 equal to the packet hash; the receipt schema gains no field and old receipts (packet==candidate by construction) still satisfy every rewritten chain, checkpoint, and disposition comparison.

Version is bumped consistently to 0.16.0 in package.json and both lockfile sites, no migration is required, and reverting the controller restores prior behavior; the only caveat is that widened-round receipts created under the new controller would not validate under a reverted one, which is inherent and acceptable.

Receipts now record packet_sha256 and candidate_sha256 separately so auditors can see which widened bytes each round read against one landing identity; the contract and SKILL.md document the prefix rule, the outside-the-repo packet placement, and --print-candidate as the identity authority, and refusal messages state the corrective action.

As a merge-readiness gate the change cannot admit unreviewed landing bytes: the prefix anchor closes the decoy-diff bypass that bare containment would allow, in-chain relaxations drop only packet==candidate assertions (the exact aliasing being removed) while candidate identity is still compared everywhere including the repeat-round and material-change triggers, and the binder recomputation is pinned by the cross-side suite.
